name: eggshell
title: Eggshell
description: For painters and decorators: a wall rolled in one deep raspberry emulsion and lettered white, with every service a trade paint tin on a shelf: wire handle, white label, the job in bold caps across a band of colour, the price in the size flash.

tokens.--font-display: label lettering: headings, the business name, the menu, prices and phone numbers (a heavy grotesque in capitals)
tokens.--font-body: body text and the small print on the tins (a sturdy book serif)
tokens.--text-s: small text: label small print, table headings, the footer
tokens.--text-l: the job name on a tin, standfirsts and customer quotes
tokens.--text-xl: section headings, the price on a service page and the number in the call block
tokens.--leading-tight: line spacing of headings and tin bands
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of small capital labels
tokens.--color-bg: the wall: the one emulsion colour the whole site is painted in
tokens.--color-text: lettering on the wall: body text and headings
tokens.--color-muted: secondary lettering on the wall: standfirsts, labels, who said a quote
tokens.--color-accent: links in the text on the wall and the keyboard focus ring
tokens.--color-sheen: wet-paint sheen: the roller laps across the wall and the highlight down each tin
tokens.--color-rail: thin lines on the wall: under the header, the shelf line, rules
tokens.--color-label: label stock: tins, tables, the call block, the skirting-board footer, the phone flash in the header
tokens.--color-print: black print on the label stock, and the price flash
tokens.--color-tin: bare metal: lids, rims, wire handles, hairlines on the labels
tokens.--color-shade: shade that turns each tin round at its edges, the edge of a table that scrolls, the ground of code blocks
tokens.--band-1: first band colour (kingfisher); also the band on a service page
tokens.--measure: widest a column of text may get
tokens.--tin-min: narrowest a tin may get before the row drops one
tokens.--space-1: hairline gap: between a label and its value
tokens.--space-2: small gap: under headings, inside flashes
tokens.--space-3: standard gap: padding in tins and panels, between paragraphs
tokens.--space-4: gap between sections and between tins
tokens.--space-5: large gap: above the call block, under the tin on a service page
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of tins and panels
tokens.--rule: thickness of printed rules and thick underlines
tokens.--focus-width: thickness of the focus ring and the line under the current menu item
tokens.--handle: height of the wire handle above each tin
tokens.--lid: heavy rule beside quotes and the call block; a tin's lid and its shelf are one and a half of it
tokens.--slant: how far the price and phone flashes lean
tokens.--roller: width of one roller pass in the wall's sheen
